channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: Skyrocketing military spending undermines development aid to world’s poor
item.description: Over 100 countries increased their military budgets, with the top ten spenders alone accounting for 73 percent of the total.

item.title: How this federal legislation would save veterans’ lives
item.description: Marcelo Assis, president of United Steelworkers (USW) Local 12000 at Southern Connecticut Gas, fervently believes the nation needs to do a better job of reaching out to those who served and connecting them to the assistance they earned.

item.title: Major US outlets withheld reporting on Trump-approved Venezuela raid
item.description: Semafor reports leading newsrooms delayed publication after warnings that coverage could endanger U.S. troops.

item.title: Legal scholars cite sweeping international law violations in US assault on Venezuela
item.description: Legal scholars, UN officials, and U.S. lawmakers cite violations of the UN Charter, Geneva Conventions, and constitutional war powers.
